name: Eternal Blessing raises the Templar's healing done, not the healing the Templar receives
contract: Eternal Blessing 705300 says "Increases your Holy damage and healing done by $s1%" ($s1 = 15). The owner ruled that its healing part raises healing done and no longer healing received (ADR 0286). The Templar casts Eternal Blessing for real (rule 4 amendment point 6); Benediction 578276 from the Templar to an ally then reads x1.15; the same Benediction from the ally to the Templar reads x1.00 with the aura on the Templar. Absolute reads at level 60 (authoring run 20261112-075042): healing done 800 without and 920 with the aura, healing taken 1000 in both.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The Templar starts without Eternal Blessing
Benediction from the Templar to the ally reads 800 of a 1000 base without the aura
Benediction from the ally to the Templar reads 1000 of a 1000 base without the aura
Eternal Blessing's cast and global cooldown
The real cast put Eternal Blessing on the Templar
Benediction from the Templar to the ally heals 15% more
Control: Benediction from the ally heals the Templar for the same amount
Benediction from the Templar to the ally reads 920 with the aura
Control: Benediction from the ally to the Templar still reads 1000 with the aura
